The camera wearer stands beside a rock-bordered garden bed, facing down toward scattered leaves. A yard bin is directly in front and within arm’s reach, while a rake is also within reach. Another person stands a few feet ahead/right on the grass, facing the work area and outside the wearer’s immediate path. The scene indicates active leaf cleanup, so the appropriate next action is to rake the leaves together and place them in the bin. This matches the social norm of maintaining a clean yard.
